Name: Ice Shards
Components: V, S, M (a handful of Icecubes)
Description: You create three frozen icicles that shudder from cold. You perform a Ranged Spell Attack against a target of your choice within reach, dealing 2d4 cold damage and reducing the targets movement speed by 10-ft on a hit. A creature slowed in this way has their limbs freezing over, recovering 5-ft of movement at the end of their subsequent turns or whenever they suffer fire damage.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the spell creates one more icicle for each slot level above 2nd.
